fields.name: Tile1b
fields.fieldText:
Frequently Asked Questions 1. What is RingCentral for Zendesk Cloud App? RingCentral for Zendesk Cloud App is a CRM platform integrated in your RingCentral phone system. This improves workflow and increases productivity by creating new records, one-click dialing,and a whole lot more. 2. Can I disable this feature for individual users? No, you can only change the app settings to remove user profiles. 3. What browsers are supported? The following browsers are supported by the App:
  • IE 11+ (Windows XP, 7, 8 or higher)
  • Firefox 25 + (Windows, Mac)
  • Chrome 30 + (Windows, Mac)
  • Safari 6.0.5 + (Mac)
4. If I have a RingCentral account, do I automatically get RingCentral for Zendesk Cloud app? RingCentral for Zendesk Cloud App is available for RingCentral Office Premium and Ultimate customers. If this feature is not available on your service plan, please call your account manager for upgrade options. 5. I can’t see the RingCentral App when I login to RingCentral for Zendesk cloud app. Does it require some special permission? No, the RingCentral App does not require any special permissions and it should work for all user profiles. Ask your RingCentral for Zendesk cloud app Administrator to ensure that RingCentral App is enabled for the Zendesk role you are a member of. 6. Can I use the same App across multiple RingCentral for Zendesk cloud app instances? Yes you can. You will need to contact your RingCentral for Zendesk cloud app Administrator to set up and enable the RingCentral Cloud App for Zendesk for each of your instances. 7. Can I use the same App across multiple browsers (IE and Firefox, for example)? The same app can be used across as many browsers as you want so long as the user is not logged into two or more browsers simultaneously. This means that the user cannot be logged into RingCentral for Zendesk cloud app on Internet Explorer and Firefox at the same time. 8. Why can’t I make a call to myself, and the incoming call features are not working? This behavior is expected – calls from your own extension to your own extension will not appear in this app. 9. The search results are not displaying records that match the caller ID. How do I solve this issue? Ensure that the format of the phone number in RingCentral for Zendesk cloud app is correct.

Steps on how to Reset Mozilla Firefox to Default Settings
  • In the upper-right corner of the Firefox window, click the Firefox menu button, then click on the “Help” button.

  • From the Help menu, choose Troubleshooting Information. If you’re unable to access the Help menu, type about:support in your address bar to bring up the Troubleshooting information page.

  • Click the “Refresh Firefox” button in the upper-right corner of the “Troubleshooting Information” page.

  • To continue, click on the “Refresh Firefox” button in the new confirmation window that opens.

  • Firefox will close itself and will revert to its default settings. When it’s done, a window will list the information that was imported. Click on the “Finish“.

RingCentral for Zendesk Integrations

This guide will walk you through on how to assist your customer in RingCentral Zendesk Integration.

Requirements:
  • RingCentral for Zendesk is available for RingCentral Office® Premium and Ultimate customers.
  • Zendesk Talk Partner Edition must be enabled within Zendesk at an additional cost.
  • You must have an active Zendesk.com account.Requires Windows XP or above, or Mac OS X Mountain Lion or above.
  • Supported browsers: Chrome 30 and above, Firefox 25 and above, Safari 6.0.5 and above, or Internet Explorer 10 and above.
It includes the following Topics:
  • Frequently Asked Questions
  • RingCentral for Zendesk Walk-through
  • App Specific Issues Anything about app specific (Ex. App not loading,functionalities not working, unable to click a certain buttons and Ticket pop-up issues)

fields.name: Tile2k
fields.fieldText:
Steps on how to Reset Safari to Default Settings
  • Click on “Safari” located in the menu bar in the top left hand corner of the screen
  • Click on “Reset Safari”
  • Place a checkmark beside all available options
  • Press the “Reset” button
  • Click on the Hard Drive icon located on the desktop
  • Browse to “Users > (Users Home) > Library > Safari folder”
  • Drag every file except “Bookmarks.plist” into the Trash
  • Browse to “User > (Users Home) > Library > Preferences”
  • Locate “com.apple.Safari.plist”, “com.apple.internetconfigpriv.plist” and “com.apple.internetconfig.plist” and drag them to the trash. NOTE: If “com.apple.internetconfigpriv.plist” does not exist, ignore it and just trash the other two files
  • Restart Safari

fields.name: Tile3a
fields.fieldText: Further Isolating the Issue What to do: If the customer is not able to log in to the app, or unable to make an outbound call, replicate the service-related issue using all availble tools such as online account,desktop app and mobile app For optimal user experience, ensure that the browser you are using is updated to the latest version. 1. You have set the correct number as your RingCentral Direct Number — you will be making and receiving calls from this number through the Zendesk interface. You can find your RingCentral Direct Number in the RingCentral Service Portal at My Settings >Phones and Numbers > Direct Numbers. 2. Login to your company’s Zendesk instance through the browser. The URL may look like https://yourcompanyname.zendesk.com/ The App will work only while the user is logged in to Zendesk. 3. Login to the App through Zendesk. Use your RingCentral Direct Number for the user name and your RingCentral password. **There are only two options to set. You can get to these options by clicking on the gear icon in the top navigation bar. 1. Direct Number: This is the number from which outgoing calls will be made. This field cannot be left blank. 2. Press 1 To Start A Call: When you make an outgoing call, RingCentral will first call you at your RingCentral Direct Number. Once you answer the call, you will have an option to press “1” before the call is connected to the other party. If this option is not enabled, then RingCentral will call your number and the dialed number simultaneously. Click the “Save” button to save your settings. These settings are cleared when the user logs out of the Softphone application, but will persist if the user logs out from Zendesk instance without logging out from the application and had also selected the option “Remember Me” on the login screen while logging in.
